findings.detail: The wrong idea 'lost-in-the-middle effects cause the failure' is a wrong option in 3 questions (S09-T2 B, S11-T2 A, S15-T2 C).
The wrong idea 'the missing JSON schema / strict mode causes the failure' is a wrong option in 3 questions (S09-T2 C, S14-T1 B, S15-T2 A).
The wrong idea 'missing few-shot examples cause the failure, or adding them fixes it' is a wrong option in 3 questions (S07-T2 A, S10-T2 C, S11-T2 D).

Two wrong options use model confidence as a filter, threshold or trigger. S04-T2 B uses a self-reported confidence threshold to trigger escalation to a human. S03-T1 B uses uncalibrated field-level confidence scores so that reviewers can filter which flags to trust; its own reason calls this confidence-based filtering, and the option does not describe the calibrated routing use that the guide teaches. The rule allows at most one.
